alternative.name: latent Brownian random walk + independent positive-time Gaussian biological nugget
alternative.initial_condition: deterministic X_0=anc; first sample has only known measurement error; subsequent population trait means include nugget S
alternative.covariance: vo*min(t_i,t_j)+delta_ij*S*(t_i>0), plus measurement variance on diagonal
alternative.algorithm: independent closed-form local-level Kalman likelihood, Nelder-Mead multi-start
alternative.relationship: high-alpha, vs/(2alpha) fixed limiting member of the source OUBM observation-law family
alternative.sampling_test: at 1-year lag finite OUBM short-term residual autocorrelation 0.9439; nugget short-term component lag correlation 0 (given latent Brownian removed)
